---
title: Settlement vs bank credit
source: internal
document_type: glossary
version: v1
effective_from: 2026-08-01
---

Razorpay uses "settled" for inclusion in a settlement file or report. That is a provider lifecycle status.

Our internal reconciliation model: settled is not bank_credited. Only a matched bank CREDIT observation proves cash in the merchant account.

MATCHED is a reconciliation result. It is not fully_reconciled and not bank_credited.
